% Fixture: failures/err-unclosed-environment
%
% Purpose: verify that a \begin without a matching \end is reported.
%
% Expected maketex behaviour:
%   - Engine: pdflatex -halt-on-error
%   - Exit: 1 (fatal error)
%   - No PDF produced
%
% Log error (exact text):
%   ! LaTeX Error: \begin{center} on input line 20 ended by \end{document}.
%
% The error surfacing system should extract:
%   - type:    error
%   - file:    main.tex
%   - line:    20  (the \begin{center} line)
%   - message: \begin{center} on input line 20 ended by \end{document}.
%
% This error format is distinct: LaTeX embeds the opening line number inside
% the message string itself. The parser must handle this double-encoding.

\documentclass{article}

\begin{document}

\begin{center}
This center environment is opened but never closed.
The document ends while LaTeX is still inside it.

\end{document}
